profile.name: Hamid R. Rezaei
profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer
profile.tagline: I’m a software engineer at HSBC in Toronto. I build Java/Spring services, data pipelines, and web applications, and I like making the work around them easier for other engineers.

timeline.title: What I’ve worked on.
timeline.description: My roles, side projects, and education, with a closer look at the work along the way.

skills.title: Tools I work with.
skills.description: Most of my work is in Java and Spring. I also work across the frontend, data, and deployment.

contact.title: Let’s talk.
contact.description: I’m interested in backend, full-stack, and senior engineering roles. If you think we could work well together, I’d like to hear from you.

timeline.title: Full-Stack Engineer
timeline.summary: I work on the services and data workflows behind post-trade operations in Agency Securities Lending.

highlights.title: Services and integrations
highlights.body: I build Java/Spring services and secure APIs, with authentication and authorization across endpoints. I also connect internal bank services and legacy Perl processing so the workflow can run through one application.

highlights.title: Making operational data useful
highlights.body: I work with product and business users on BigQuery and Looker Studio analytics, including the data-query logic and workflows behind them.

highlights.title: Replacing the old release scripts
highlights.body: I led the move to configurable Jenkins/Groovy pipelines. They automate builds, tests, security scans, versioning, and deployments.

timeline.title: Full-Stack Engineer
timeline.summary: I worked on data synchronization, real-time processing, and internal tools used to support trading systems.

highlights.title: A reusable synchronization product
highlights.body: I owned the architecture of a Spring Batch product for data transfer and synchronization. New use cases could be configured without duplicating the implementation. I also mentored a developer joining the project.

highlights.title: Processing events in the right order
highlights.body: I contributed to a real-time ETL application for trading data. We used acknowledgments, retries, and transactional controls to preserve lifecycle-event ordering and reduce the risk of data loss.

highlights.title: A secure file-retrieval tool
highlights.body: I designed and owned a Spring Boot service with a React frontend. It enforced access controls on the backend and used a daily cache to avoid repeatedly traversing the filesystem.

highlights.title: Seeing what the applications were doing
highlights.body: I built reusable, parameterized Grafana dashboards and Geneos alerting scripts to make application health easier to monitor.

timeline.title: Software Developer & DevOps Engineer
timeline.summary: I developed regulatory trade-reporting features for the Americas and built the automation used to test and release them.

highlights.title: Regression analysis in three hours
highlights.body: I built a platform that split large datasets across parallel Jenkins pipelines and brought the results together in a multithreaded Spring Boot application. Analysis that had taken a week could be completed in three hours.

highlights.title: Reporting across the Americas
highlights.body: I delivered reporting functionality in Java and Drools for CFTC, SEC, and Canadian regulators.

highlights.title: The work around the application
highlights.body: I built modular Jenkins/Groovy pipelines connecting GitHub, Maven, Nexus, Jira, Ansible, and ServiceNow. I also refactored legacy applications and took part in L2/L3 production support.

timeline.title: Master of Engineering
timeline.summary: I used mathematical modeling and R to study hydrological and spatial problems, turning domain concepts into equations and statistical analysis.

timeline.title: Computer Science & Mathematics Teacher
timeline.summary: I taught computer science and mathematics at two high schools and through private tutoring. Topics included algorithms, flowcharts, spreadsheets, algebra, and probability.

timeline.title: Bachelor of Science
timeline.summary: I studied civil engineering, with a strong grounding in mathematics and quantitative analysis.

timeline.title: Platform & AI projects
timeline.summary: I’ve also worked on a platform proof of concept, an in-product assistant, and AI tools for engineering teams.

highlights.title: A multi-service platform proof of concept
highlights.body: I co-architected a working proof of concept under a limited timeline. My work included the React frontend, configuration-driven REST APIs, an Active Directory authentication gateway, and an in-product assistant.
details: The query API exposed datasets with 100+ columns as filterable, sortable endpoints without writing each endpoint separately.
Components were identified for reuse by other teams. The data-query logic was also adapted for BigQuery and Looker Studio dashboards.

metric.label: One selected trade type · defined evaluation period

highlights.title: An assistant inside the product
highlights.body: I built a Spring AI and React assistant that could use the active filters, table metadata, and displayed results. Users could ask questions about what they were looking at without copying data into another tool.
details: The service supported JSON and streamed SSE responses. I selected the context sent to the model to avoid unnecessary token use.
I extracted the frontend and backend components for reuse and shared them with an interested partner team.

highlights.title: Helping teams use coding agents
highlights.body: I built reusable agent instructions and script-backed skills connecting source control, work tracking, documentation, delivery, and logs. I helped my team and nearby teams get started through hands-on training.
details: Training covered prompting, models, tokens, context windows, agent skills, and MCP.

timeline.title: man-agent-ment
timeline.summary: I made this open-source framework to give AI coding agents a consistent way to plan work, check changes, and hand work over between sessions.

timeline.title: BuyOrRent
timeline.summary: I’m building a financial-calculation service in TypeScript and Hono on Cloudflare Workers. The HTTP APIs and MCP tools share the same calculation logic. The broader buy-versus-rent comparison is still in development.

timeline.title: Buildean
timeline.summary: I co-founded this construction-management product, which is in beta. I own the Java/Spring backend, PostgreSQL data model, Firebase security, and GCP infrastructure.

careerNote: Joined HSBC through FDM in 2021. Became a permanent HSBC employee in September 2023, continuing on the Data Service Layer team.
